parent_objective: audit strong trainable-scope diagnostic result before proof-retention or repeat design
blocked_by: M1299 strong diagnostic result meets eval thresholds exactly and requires audit before any escalation
supersedes: direct PPO or promotion from M1299 diagnostic checkpoint

public_gates: M1300 must audit M1299 strong result
M1300 must record the boundary-threshold caveat
M1300 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostic split success as paper-level evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first strong fusion/head source-history directional diagnostic
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats boundary-threshold result as promotion-ready
stop if audit starts PPO directly
stop if audit omits mutation and split-eval caveats
fallback_plan: if strong result is robust enough, route to repeat or proof-retention design
if boundary caveat dominates, route to fresh seed/split repeat
if artifacts show leakage or mutation issue, repair tooling before rerun
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: third milestone in trainable-scope escalation branch

admission_evidence: M1299 eval row/group fractions are exactly 0.25
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1300 audits fixed-current source-history diagnostics and does not evaluate closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit correct-history versus wrong-history directional metrics
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Boundary-threshold strong result must be repeated or guarded before PPO.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: M1299 can be audited as a strong but boundary-threshold source-history trainable-scope diagnostic that should route to repeat/proof-retention design rather than PPO.
success_criteria: audit records PPO and promotion remain blocked
no PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit omits split-eval or mutation caveat
private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1300 passes if it audits M1299 as strong diagnostic evidence while keeping PPO and promotion blocked.
